subject: Demo recap + success hypotheses and 30-day trial setup roadmap
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Gomez <alyssa.gomez@rivermark.ai>, Tom Fischer <tom.fischer@rivermark.ai>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 25 Jul 2027 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: Demo recap + success hypotheses and 30-day trial setup roadmap

Hi Alyssa & Tom,

Thanks again for taking time today to walk through the demo. High-level recap and a 30-day trial proposal below.

Pain points (what you confirmed):
- High false positives on entity extraction from legacy NER pipeline (~18% FPR)
- Latency spikes during peak ingestion (avg p95 = 2.3s for enrichment calls)
- Lack of consistent prompt/eval suite to track quality regressions across releases

Success hypotheses (what a win looks like):
1) Reduce extracted-entity false positive rate by >= 40% on your sample set (A/B vs current pipeline)
2) Achieve p95 latency <= 1.2s for the enrichment path under expected QPS
3) Ensure reproducible evals for top 20 production prompts with daily alerting for regressions

Proposed 30-day trial scope:
- Deployment: Redwood Hosted trial project with dedicated reserved capacity (small pool)
- Models: start with rdx-3b-q4 and benchmark against an accuracy-tuned rdx-7b baseline
- Data: we'll run on a 10k-record sample you provide (PII redacted) + a 500-record holdout for acceptance
- Evals: create a prompt set of 20 prioritized prompts, plus 2 automated E2E regression checks
- Owners:
  - Redwood: Karthik (SaaS lead) — trial exec; Priyom (Solutions) — technical onboarding; Marissa (CS) — success manager
  - Rivermark: Alyssa — product owner; Tom — engineering lead; Procurement contact TBD
- Access & security:
  - We'll need an S3 read bucket (signed URLs) + temporary service account for the trial
  - SOC 2 summary shared in attachments; we can arrange a short security call if needed

Milestone timeline (approx):
Day 0–3: account/project creation, access request, sample dataset upload
Day 4–9: baseline runs (rdx-7b) + rdx-3b-q4 quant benchmark
Day 10–17: prompt tuning, eval suite creation, latency tuning
Day 18–25: A/B comparison, acceptance runs on holdout
Day 26–30: results review, decision / next-step recommendation (scale or Private)

Attachments: trial-plan workbook, access-checklist, mutual-action-plan stub.

Immediate asks for Rivermark (answer by Wed 28 Jul preferred):
- Confirm dataset owner + S3 location or secure upload method
- Identify procurement contact (so we can send MSA/PO steps)
- Any required IP/retention constraints we should note for the trial

I'll schedule a short 30-minute kickoff for Monday (Jul 26) 10am PT but can move to suit your team.

Thanks,
Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0192

Attachments: 20270725_trial_plan.xlsx (workbook), access-checklist.md, mutual-action-plan.pdf

From: Alyssa Gomez <alyssa.gomez@rivermark.ai>

Cc: Tom Fischer <tom.fischer@rivermark.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 25 Jul 2027 18:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo recap + success hypotheses and 30-day trial setup roadmap

Thanks Karthik — helpful recap.

Quick answers:
- Dataset: I'll send the 10k sample via secure SFTP by EOD Monday; dataset owner is me.
- Procurement: procurement@rivermark.ai (I copied them on this thread in a separate email)
- Data residency: must remain in us-west region; we cannot move data outside the US during the trial

Question: For the p95 latency target, will the trial run simulate our peak ingestion (15 QPS) or be single-request benchmarking? We want the trial to reflect production-like load.

Agree to kickoff Mon 26 10amPT; if you can include Priyom on the tech onboarding section that would be great.

Best,
Alyssa
Alyssa Gomez
Head of Product, Rivermark Analytics
alyssa.gomez@rivermark.ai | +1-206-555-0104

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>

Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Procurement <procurement@rivermark.ai>
Date: Mon, 26 Jul 2027 08:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo recap + success hypotheses and 30-day trial setup roadmap

Thanks — great.

Short answers and clarifications:
- Load: We'll run both single-request baselines and a production-like QPS simulation (15 QPS) during the latency tuning window (Day 10–17). We'll provide the test harness and a sample load script; Priyom will lead that.
- Data residency: noted — trial deployment will be pinned to us-west region.
- Kickoff: Confirmed for Mon 26 10am PT. Agenda: intros (10m), access & network steps (10m), initial baseline plan & owners (10m).

Next immediate actions (Redwood):
- Priyom to send onboarding checklist + test harness (today)
- Marissa to open the trial project and invite Alyssa/Tom
- Karthik to share the mutual action plan + PO guidance to procurement

Alyssa — once you upload the sample, reply with the SFTP path or give us a signed URL and we'll pick it up.

Karthik
